mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hot_question(`standard_question`, `count`, `stat_date`) VALUES (#{q}, 1, #{date}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `count` = `count` + 1
mapper.select: SELECT standard_question AS question, SUM(count) AS total_count FROM hot_question WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY standard_question ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 10
